content: pandas-ta-classic (PyPI, 0.6.52) exposes a df.ta accessor: df.ta.sma(length=N, append=True), df.ta.rsi(length=14, append=True), df.ta.macd(append=True), df.ta.bbands(length=20, append=True) all operate on a DataFrame with lowercase open/high/low/close/volume columns and append new columns in place. All are rolling/window based (not full-history joins) so are point-in-time safe as long as computed on a properly time-sorted, non-leaked slice of the frame.
